Marta Lopez: Quick Q — my EAD (C08) shows expiry 2026-05-02 but I filed renewal last week. Offer/start at Redwood is 2026-05-01. Can I actually start on 5/1 while renewal is pending? What happens to benefits & payroll if Im not yet authorized for work?

Jae Park (People Ops): Hi Marta :wave: short version: we must have proof of work authorization to complete Form I-9 by the first day of employment. If your category gets an automatic extension with a timely-filed I-765, we may be able to proceed with documentation. If not, we usually delay pay/attestation but can do preboarding and orientations. Priya to confirm legal specifics.

Priya Rao (Legal): Few points: 1) For certain EAD categories USCIS grants an automatic extension for 180 days if you filed a timely I-765 and meet criteria (see USCIS Guidance). For C08, eligibility can depend on filing date and receipt; check the I-797C receipt details. 2) Receipt notice alone does not always equate to authorization unless covered by the extension policy. Employer still needs to be confident on I-9. 3) We can accept the receipt plus a copy of the previously valid EAD to document intent, but payroll/legal will need to approve any exception. I can review your receipt when you upload it.

PayrollBot: FYI: Benefits enrollment windows are tied to hire effective date. If start is moved to next payroll period, benefits eligibility/effective date may shift. Payroll needs an exception request to backdate benefits if appropriate. W-4 and direct deposit can be submitted prior to pay activation.

Sourav Banerjee (New Hire): I actually filed my I-765 on 2026-04-12 (e-file). No receipt yet. Passport ok. I need health coverage starting May ideally — is there a way for coverage to kick in on 5/1 but pay to start after I-9 is done?

Jae Park (People Ops): We can request an exception but it requires approval from Benefits + Payroll + Legal. Typical path we use: 1) create a benefits hold ticket marking tentative effective date, 2) hire date remains 5/1 for onboarding docs, 3) block payroll/pay access until I-9 verification, 4) once I-9 completed we confirm retroactive benefits effective date. I'll draft the payroll/benefits note now.
